008B4502._added: Added 12 Sep 2026. ENTM 008B4503 ATX_ENTM_CAMP_Ally_CamBot 'Lite Ally: Cambot Nine', NPC 008B3C96, quest ATX_COMP_Quest_Camp_Lite_Cambot. XALG Premium -> Atom Shop. Buff from MGEF 009005EC ATX_Reporters_Instinct_Cambot (Reporter's Instinct). No vendor chest exists, so no Inventory expand. Art extracted 24 Sep 2026: atx_camp_ally_cambot (main), _c1 (console), _c2.

_note: EXCEPTIONS, not a roster. The ally list is now DISCOVERED in src/build_allies_pets_weather_json.py (discover_allies): any COBJ whose EDID matches COMP_Constructible_CampObject or LiteAlly and is not in drift_exclude. A new seasonal ally needs NOTHING here — furn comes from CNAM_FormID, name from CNAM_FULL, obtain from the FURN's XALG/SCORE_S prefix, the display name from the ENTM's 'Lite Ally: X', vendor_base from a token search, and buff_token from the token itself. All verified against all 20 allies. Rows below are kept because they OVERRIDE a field the derivation cannot get right: the five pre-storefront quest allies have no ENTM and so no derivable display name; Maul, Raider Punk, Sam and Daphne build a PKIN pack-in rather than a FURN; Daphne and Leo need an entm_override; Grandma Junko and Joey Bello have buff EDIDs their token does not match. Merging is field by field, so a row only has to carry the value that differs — anything left blank is derived.

furniture_frame._note: Which carousel frame is the ally's FURNITURE, for the Allies Furniture expand. Bethesda's frame order is not consistent, so the default is a rule and the exceptions are data. Verified frame-by-frame 12 Sep 2026 against the avif set.

drift_exclude._note: Ally COBJs the drift check should NOT flag. Keyed by COBJ FormID. Moved here out of _ALLY_DRIFT_EXCLUDE in build_allies_pets_weather_json.py so the builder's warning and verify_camp_items_json.py's roster check read ONE list — two lists in two files is the drift this table exists to prevent.

quest_lines_note: Quest names are the game's own strings. Ally: Narrow Escape [00574625] and Ally: Crash Landing [0054EB40] are the COBJ-referenced intro quests (names from COBJ_Export_March_2026, whose ReferencedBy column carried quest FULL names). Ally: Raider Punk / Ally: Scavenger / Ally: Settler Wanderer are the COMP_Quest_Intro_Lite_* FULL names in ALLYDLG_Export_September_2026_Quests. Random-encounter recruitment and Beckett's Rollins Labor Camp start are from the Fallout wiki, not the TSVs. QUST2 exports do not include COMP quests.
